chunks: God: there is no god but He, the living, eternal, self-subsisting, ever sustaining.
ai.seo_question: What are the key divine attributes mentioned in the verse 'Allah la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyu al-qayyum'?
ai.summary: Known as the Ayat al-Kursi (Verse of the Throne), this verse is widely regarded in Shia tradition as the greatest verse of the Quran, encapsulating the attributes of divine sovereignty and eternal self-subsistence (Al-Qayyum). It serves as a cornerstone for understanding Tawhid, emphasizing that God's life and sustenance are intrinsic and independent of any external cause, a concept deeply explored in the exegesis of Al-Tabarsi and Al-Tabatabai.
